rows.30:4268:
The hallway was plainly visible in the morning light.
The usual hallway was there.
The usual hallway, where you could see from one end to the other.
And he had been lying in front of his classroom.
"...I made it."
That was all he could murmur.
Maybe it had been a dream.
Maybe he'd been worn out from studying and had a bad dream.
The classmate was giving him a strange look.
And then the classmate said:
"What's with you?
You've got a weird bruise on your neck."
At that, he checked in a mirror.{p}
rows.30:6668:
Then she burst into tears and clung to your chest.
She thought:
And just when I thought I'd finally gotten close enough to talk to him.
If I break up with {a}, the days of watching him from afar will start all over again.
I can't bear that...
As she was thinking that, her eyes fell on your throat.{p}
